name: Kagaku to Mahou no Kasou Sekai Vol. 4
original_name: 科学と魔法の仮想世界Vol.4
source:
Meru's best friend Claire joined up with Akira to practice spellcasting in Fantasia.
Several days later, when exams were finished in the real world, freshman Ruka and senior club president Ami
approached Akira with a request to help them in the virtual world.
